Matheus Fernandes Moreno

I’m a second-year master’s student in Computer Science, on the Quantum Information track, at Sorbonne University. I’m currently carrying out my capstone internship at the National Institute of Informatics.

I obtained my undergraduate degree in Electronic and Computer Engineering from the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro. Before starting my graduate studies, I worked as a machine learning engineer for three years.

I am interested in myriad research topics, from quantum information processing to the foundational aspects of quantum mechanics. My present work involves estimation and distillation protocols for quantum networks.

You can reach me at matheus [dot] fernandes_moreno [at] etu.sorbonne-universite.fr.
